similarityThreshold.description:
Jaro–Winkler similarity is the inverse string metric measuring an edit distance between two sequences.
Making this value higher (closer to 1), increases the strictness of the match and making it lower (closer to 0)
results in more merging (fewer result). The best value to use depends on the inputs, but the default value of
means that roughly ¾ of the text must match.

@see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jaro%E2%80%93Winkler_distance

lcsThreshold.description: Minimum longest common subsequence length to be considered for merging.

replaceWith.description:
If the #merge value is `replace`, this is the value used to replace the varying parts of the string.
The default value is a single asterisk `*` (U+002A), but any value may be specified. If the value is null,
the varying part is elided.

storeIndexes.description:
If true then store the locations of all elements in each {@link MergeSimilarCluster}. Enabling this feature
increases memory usage to O(N) where N is the size of the input collection.

title:
Options for merging multiple strings that represent the "same" message using Jaccard similarity.

By default, the first message of multiple similar messages is returned, but the dissimilar parts may be replaced
with a string (or elided) or regular expressions may be returned. In the latter case, there will be a capturing
group around each dissimilar subsequence to allow higher-level processing of these or similar inputs.

The default behavior is to replace varying sequences by a single asterisk (`*`).

@see Value#mergeSimilar
@see Arry#mergeSimilar
name: MergeSimilarSpec
